_readme: Retrieval eval cases for Statekeeper recall. Ids refer to the frozen snapshot named in 'snapshot'. expect = list of groups; a group is satisfied when ANY of its state ids is injected, or (if given) any of its regexes matches an injected line. Every group must be satisfied for 'full'; 'hit' = at least one group satisfied. stale = state ids that must NOT be injected for this prompt (still 'active' in the store but contradicted by a newer fact or by reality). channel 'hook' = per-prompt injection; every case also records whether its expected ids are reachable from the SessionStart core block. verified: how the truth was checked (gh = gh pr view at 2026-11-20 ~15:3x UTC; file = path exists on disk; code = read in repo; store = point-in-time store statement only, NOT independently verified; owner = John's own words recorded as owner/verified trust). also_ok = states adjudicated by hand (reading the injected text on the first baseline run) as relevant restatements or partial answers that are not the primary expected state: they count for the lenient metrics and are not noise. Adjudication is mine, not John's; treat the lenient numbers as an upper bound.
